_about: Press page data, in date order. Public fields: date_display, publication, writer, kind, about, excerpt. Excerpts are positive passages only, exactly as printed, always with the publication and date (research/04 §2.1 quote policy). Internal: source, confidence, notes_internal, and records with "publish": false. Most items are known through the band's own press page (reprints); the originals are unseen.
intro: What the press said, in date order. Quotes are exactly as printed.

items.notes_internal: Title and issue are added when the clipping is found (LL-22). Do not use the secondary 'Hot Prospects' title.
